requirements.statement: The complete submitted RTL bundle elaborates the pinned serv_synth_wrapper top as Verilog 2005.
requirements.acceptance_rule: All seventeen required RTL files exist, no unexpected file is present, and the frozen top and parameter configuration elaborate without a submission-induced compile error.
requirements.verification_intent: Development visible completeness/interface check, synthesis dry run, and public preapproval Yosys equivalence gate; not independently calibrated or frozen.

requirements.statement: The public wrapper signature and frozen parameter values are preserved.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The wrapper ports, widths, directions, parameter names, and frozen evaluator values match the CPUInterfaceSpec.
requirements.verification_intent: Development visible structural contract check plus a planned hidden elaboration matrix.

requirements.statement: RV32I architectural behavior for the frozen configuration remains equivalent to the pinned baseline.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The hidden compliance subset and architectural differential traces match the immutable baseline for all evaluated cases.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned hidden F2P and architectural-trace comparison; the observed development suite is only a bounded external-output cycle differential.

requirements.statement: Instruction bus, data bus, register-file, reset, and timer-interrupt behavior remains cycle-visible equivalent.
requirements.acceptance_rule: For identical evaluator inputs, the normalized output and state-observation sequence has no additional, removed, or shifted externally visible event.
requirements.verification_intent: A development four-profile cycle differential covers always-ack, deterministic stalls, mid-run reset, and timer interrupt, but the suite and coverage are incomplete and not frozen.

requirements.statement: The submission changes only allowlisted RTL files and preserves repository structure and notices.
requirements.acceptance_rule: No file is added, deleted, or renamed; read-only projected files are byte-identical; no evaluator path is present; network access remains disabled.
requirements.verification_intent: Development visible and private runners enforce the seventeen-file manifest, digests, no symlinks, and size/scope limits; calibration and freeze remain pending.

requirements.statement: Baseline and submission both complete the same frozen synthesis and timing flow before QoR comparison.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A QoR metric is valid only when both subjects use matching content-addressed environment, library, constraints, script, seeds, limits, and parser with no unresolved warning classified as blocking.
requirements.verification_intent: Development generic-proxy extraction has been reproduced separately with Yosys 0.65 and 0.33; no frozen physical synthesis/STA environment exists.

requirements.statement: Area is reported only in the frozen flow's declared unit and provenance.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The result records raw baseline and submission area, units, library digest, run seeds, per-run values, aggregation rule, and parser evidence; missing or non-finite data is not scored.
requirements.verification_intent: Development evidence now includes five same-server baseline/official-alternate physical area and STA pairs with exact selected-metric repeatability; the policy, environment, cross-host result, thresholds, and independent review remain unfrozen.

requirements.statement: Timing and performance non-regression gates precede any area reward.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A submission that violates the frozen timing or cycle-visible performance limits is fail_ppa or functionally failed and receives no area-improvement score.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned private timing parser and differential cycle checks.

requirements.acceptance_rule: Empty, truncated, unmapped, constant-output, interface-pruned, timeout, parser-spoof, and functionally incorrect subjects cannot produce an eligible QoR result.
requirements.verification_intent: One behavior mutant is blocked by the bounded functional gate before synthesis; the full false-improvement mutation campaign remains planned.

requirements.statement: Scoring and benchmark admission remain unavailable until independent freeze.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Before environment, thresholds, repeat policy, scoring, rights, packet digest, and independent admission are frozen, raw observations remain explicitly development-only and unscored.

excluded_claims: A bounded four-case cycle differential ran for the baseline, one killed mutant, and one syntax-equivalent positive; this is not hidden F2P, complete P2P, compliance, or formal-equivalence calibration.

The public preapproval Yosys gate passes baseline identity and one equivalent positive and kills one behavior mutant across two Yosys versions; this does not freeze the gate or establish complete formal, ISA, F2P, or hidden P2P coverage.

The public four-instruction software smoke passes the baseline and rejects one known false-improvement functional mutant; controlled syntax, scope, missing-tool, and timeout cases remain development calibration, not ISA compliance or hidden F2P/P2P.

Five same-server physical area and STA pairs were observed for the baseline and official upstream structural alternate with exact selected-metric repeatability; power activity, workload performance, cross-host reproduction, policy freeze, and a positive physical QoR reference remain unavailable, and the alternate was larger in every pair.
No environment, threshold, repeatability policy, physical PPA flow, scoring profile, projection digest, or benchmark admission is frozen.
